statement_scope: Whole pandemic.html task, with its explicit original survey Section7.2: for a sequence of finite connected graphs with arbitrary meeting/edge rates and independent exponential traversal times, let T_ij be the FPP time and pi_ij its minimizing path. Conjecture1 asks whether max{xi_ab:(a,b) in pi_ij}/E T_ij ->0 in probability implies T_ij/E T_ij ->1 in probability. All objects may depend on n. The selected Theorem7 proves a stronger uniform two-sided relation between normalized standard deviation and the L0 size of the largest traversal time on the random minimizing path. The original one question is counted once; lattice, complete-graph and coverage-process results are context.

original_statement.verbatim_html:
WLLN for first-passage percolation on finite graphs

Update (6/2015). Solved myself (bad form, I know) in this paper.

My survey paper on "interacting particle systems repackaged as social dynamics" has many open problems. My favorite concerns general conditions for a first passage percolation time on a general graph to be weakly concentrated around its mean (in the WLLN sense) -- see section 7.2 of the survey paper.
